name: SnakeCE
summary: Snake, with the speed, the board size and the colours up to you.
description:
Snake for the TI-84 Plus CE. Before a game you set the speed, the size of the pixels — which is really the size of the board — and the colours; larger boards suit the higher speeds.

On the setup screen the keys named either side of each number change it. In a game, [2nd] pauses and [clear] quits. Your best score is kept between games.
author: LogicalJoe

uninstall.text: Your high score is in an appvar called SnakeCE, which the game made itself. That is a different variable from the program SNAKECE this has just removed -- it is listed under AppVars rather than Prgm. It has been left alone, so reinstalling picks up where you stopped. Delete it by hand from [2nd] [+], 2:Mem Mgmt/Del, B:AppVars if you would rather start over.
